title: MemorySearchResult
description: The result of a memory recall: a list of candidate MemoryArtifacts plus provider status. Every entry is a candidate (claim_status=candidate|held_out, never served by this result alone) and carries its external_source_handle + lineage. The result is bound to the (tenant_id, container) it was queried under and asserts NO canonical truth — promotion happens only through the downstream gates.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the recall was scoped to; echoes the request so cross-tenant mixing is detectable.

container.description: Container/project scope the recall was bounded to.

provider_id.description: The adapter that served the recall, e.g. 'memory.emulator@v1'.

results.description: Candidate MemoryArtifacts. Each is retrieved, NOT served.

claim_status.description: A recall result can only be candidate or held_out — it can NEVER be 'promoted' by recall alone.
